name: toolzen
description: Fast, private, browser-first online tools platform.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-integrity.mjs && node scripts/check-icons.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-seo.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.build:static: node scripts/write-ads-txt.mjs && NEXT_OUTPUT=export next build && node scripts/check-export.mjs
scripts.deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL:-https://thetoolzen.com} npm run build:static && npx wrangler deploy
